cuts.item: Positions cut in the needs-based budget, restored by override

statements.statement: School committee member said the override amount is the total needed to level fund the schools next year minus anticipated cuts.
Ballot question language asks to assess an additional amount for the school department for the fiscal year beginning July 1 2024.
Board recommended approval of the override article by 3-2.
Amount for the FY25 omnibus town budget article; board recommended approval 5-0.
A member said ARPA money of this size was factored into the override and that most of it is used for one-time costs.
A member said the override restores positions cut in the needs-based budget.
